role: Technical white paper (v1.3) specifying live DFA alpha1 (beat clock, dual gate, trailing-median artifact filter, status machine), post-session alpha1 interpretation (ectopic shadows, sustained crossings), the training-load ladder, auto-FTP, route-matched load substitution, training readiness (daily and live), phone/Watch strap fusion and per-split alpha1/decoupling.
toplevel: Markdown only. Appendix C source map lists 27 repository paths and 6 test files; all exist. Appendix A constants were checked against LiveDFAAnalyzer.swift, Alpha1ReportCards+Report.swift, ThresholdCards+Cards.swift, RouteLibrary.swift, RouteTRIMPEstimator.swift, FTPAutoEstimator.swift, WorkoutMetadata.swift, Constants+RecoveryScore.swift and WorkoutRecorder+Ticker.swift and match.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load
units.does: no behavioural claim: title block: v1.3, author, source revision e028039, scoring version v3.1.oct2026, citation.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > Executive Summary
units.does: Summarizes: live alpha1 published only with >=64 beats and >=118 s span on the dropout-compensated beat clock, trailing-median filter interpolating artifacts, >6% corrected withheld, five-state status; ectopic shadows and 180 s sustained crossings; load ladder with read-time power TSS and route estimate; route-matched substitution; recovery-aware readiness; phone/Watch fusion using Watch RR only after phone silence. Matches LiveDFAAnalyzer, Alpha1ReportCards, ThresholdCards, TrainingLoadPrecedence, RouteTRIMPEstimator, ReadinessScoring, WorkoutRecorder+Ticker and WorkoutRRMerge.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.1 Live DFA α1
units.does: Lists live parameters W=120 s, C=20 s, 64 beats, 2 s slack (118 s), stalled after 40 s, reject above 0.06. Code: LiveDFAAnalyzer init defaults windowSec 120 / cadenceSec 20 (LiveDFAAnalyzer.swift:264), minBeatsForFit 64, windowSpanSlackSec 2.0, maxCorrectedFraction 0.06, stalled at cadenceSec*2 (:542).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.1 Live DFA α1 > 3.1.1 Beat clock (dropout compensation)
units.does: Specifies the beat clock start = max(nextStart, wall - originWall + originBeat) and the offline closed form t_ms + running max of wall lead; a unit test checks equality. Code: LiveDFAAnalyzer.BeatClock.stamp (LiveDFAAnalyzer.swift:600-610), WorkoutAnalyzer.gapCorrectedOffsetsMs (WorkoutAnalyzer.swift:792-802).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.1 Live DFA α1 > 3.1.2 Ingest, trim, gate and progress
units.does: Specifies ingest: ignore before session start, append re-stamped beats and set lastBeatAt if any, trim t_ms < newest - W, fill = min(count/64, span/118), recompute every >=C s else refresh; tick(now) once per second when no beats arrive; gate count>=64 and span>=118. Code: ingest/trimToWindow/publishFillProgress/tick/hasEnoughDataForFit (LiveDFAAnalyzer.swift:228-345); WorkoutRecorder+Ticker.ingestStrapBeatsAndDeriveHR calls dfa.tick() when no new beats (WorkoutRecorder+Ticker.swift:295-300).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.1 Live DFA α1 > 3.1.3 Artifact filter (trailing-median relative-deviation filter)
units.does: Specifies the cleaner: <8 values unchanged; mark rr<300 or >2000; with >=3 accepted in a <=5 reference take sorted[count/2] and mark >20% deviation; interpolate marked beats linearly from nearest unmarked neighbours (copy single neighbour); return values and marked count. Code: cleanRRForDFA/artifactMask/isArtifactBeat/interpolatingArtifacts (LiveDFAAnalyzer.swift:461-540).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.1 Live DFA α1 > 3.1.4 Recompute and status machine
units.does: Specifies recompute outcomes (too many artifacts > 0.06, fit failed, else publish) and refresh order (stalled >40 s, gate failure -> warmup, value -> ok, after stalled -> warmup, else unchanged) with the invariant alpha1 non-nil iff ok. Code: recompute/fitOrExplain/markFitFailed/markTooNoisy/markWarmingUp/clearPublishedValue/refreshStatus/markStalled (LiveDFAAnalyzer.swift:348-575).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.1 Live DFA α1 > 3.1.5 DFA core and bands
units.does: Specifies the DFA core: n>=64, integrate, log-spaced box sizes ratio 2^(1/8) from lo to min(hi, n/4), detrended fluctuation per size, log-log slope and R^2 (alpha1 4-16 needing 3 sizes; alpha2 16-64 with n>=256); bands Easy >=0.75, Threshold 0.50-0.75, Very Hard <0.50 via one shared function. Code: DFAAnalyzer.compute/integratedSeries/alpha2Exponent/logSpacedBoxSizes/computeFluctuation/detrendedSumOfSquares/leastSquaresLine/logLogRegression (DFAAnalysis.swift:29-175), LiveDFAAnalyzer.Band.display.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.1 Live DFA α1 > 3.1.6 Offline re-analysis
units.does: Specifies offline re-analysis: >=64 points on the gap-corrected timeline, duration > 120 s, sweep t = 120,140,... with O(n) two-pointer windows, clean and reject >0.06, emit (t, alpha1, R^2); per-second samples take the latest reading <20 s old else nil. Code: WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer.reanalyze/wallClockTimeline/fit/applyReadings (WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer.swift:66-140), RRWindowSweep.range (SleepBoundaryResolver.swift:29).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.2 Post-hoc interpretation of α1
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for post-hoc alpha1 interpretation.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.2 Post-hoc interpretation of α1 > 3.2.1 Ectopic shadows
units.does: Specifies ectopic shadows: open a dip below 0.75, track the deepest point; on recovery with 0 < span <= 120 s emit a shadow [max(0,start-60), offset+120); open dip at end unlabeled; shadow samples excluded from avg/max/min and band totals. Code: ectopicShadows/closeDip/extendDip/Alpha1Dip.deepen/shadow with windowSec 120, approachPad 60, recoveryPad 120 (Alpha1ReportCards+Report.swift:226-298), collectCleanAlpha1Values/cleanMinMaxAvg.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.2 Post-hoc interpretation of α1 > 3.2.2 Band totals and the first sustained AT1 crossing
units.does: Specifies band totals with dt = min(max(1, gap), 5) s (1 s first), shadows skipped, and the first sustained AT1 crossing: after 120 s, >=0.75 arms and resets, <0.75 while armed accumulates from a pending (offset, HR) until 180 s. Code: alpha1Stats/alpha1BandTotals/sampleSeconds/Alpha1Bands.add/AT1CrossDetector.step (Alpha1ReportCards+Report.swift:343-457).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.2 Post-hoc interpretation of α1 > 3.2.3 Crossing list and the LT1 card
units.does: Specifies the crossing list: per-threshold trackers for 0.75 and 0.50 from 120 s, dt = max(1, gap) uncapped, arming on the previous sample, down-crossing emitted at 180 s sustain, up-crossing when recovering after a committed down, first 6 events; LT1 card shows HR/time of the first AT1 down-crossing with HR, labeled estimate, not offered as LTHR. Code: detectAlpha1Crossings/advance/release/commitIfSustained with alpha1WarmupSec 120, alpha1SustainSec 180, prefix(6) (ThresholdCards+Cards.swift:129-196).

flags.text: Two independent sustained-crossing detectors implement the same 120 s warm-up / 180 s sustain rule with different timing rules: AT1CrossDetector.step caps dt at 5 s and skips shadow samples (Alpha1ReportCards+Report.swift:400-457) while ThresholdCards.detectAlpha1Crossings uses uncapped dt and does not exclude shadows (ThresholdCards+Cards.swift:129-196). The paper documents both, but the same session can report a different first AT1 crossing time on the summary and on the crossing list/LT1 card.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.3 Training load > 3.3.1 Load ladder
units.does: Specifies the ladder: power (stored IF with >60 s moving time, else stored power TSS, else read-time (NP/FTP)^2*h*100), route estimate when it replaces a dropout HR load, hrTSS, MET load, Banister TRIMP, route estimate last. Code: TrainingLoadPrecedence.stored/readTimePowerTSS (TrainingLoadPrecedence.swift:83-109), WorkoutMetadata.storedPowerTSS/routeEstimateReplacesHRLoad/computedMETLoad.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.3 Training load > 3.3.2 Functional threshold power
units.does: Specifies FTP: running-family sports use the running FTP else the auto-estimate, cycling only user-entered, others none; auto FTP = round(0.95 x best 1200 s window mean over last 90 days of running-family workouts where >=1080 per-second readings exist), recomputed at most every 7 days unless forced; tier 1 evaluated at read time. Code: FTPAnchors.current/ftp(for:) (TrainingLoadPrecedence.swift:30-44), FTPAutoEstimator.recomputeIfNeeded/recompute/bestEffort/bestTwentyMinuteMeanPower/perSecondPower/recentRunningWorkouts/isRunningFamily/persist (FTPAutoEstimator.swift:44-190).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.3 Training load > 3.3.3 hrTSS, Banister TRIMP and MET load
units.does: Specifies hrTSS = TRIMP/TRIMP_ref*100 (ref = 60 min at LTHR, else 0.88 HRmax), Banister TRIMP per beat with HRR clamp and A,k = 0.64,1.92 male / 0.86,1.67 female, >=30 beats, Edwards fallback when HRmax or rest HR unknown; MET load = MET-h/12*100 reported above 0.5, per-sample path >=30 samples with METs on >=1/4, durations clamped 1-30 s, bucket fallback needing >50 m, 0.5-60 km/h and >=60 s. Code: WorkoutAnalyzer.computeTRIMP/banisterTRIMP/edwardsTRIMPFallback (WorkoutAnalyzer.swift:198-260), WorkoutMetadata.perSampleMETLoad/sampleSeconds/bucketMETLoad/averageKmh/loadFromMETHours (WorkoutMetadata.swift:545-630).

flags.text: The paper's tier 5 'stored TRIMP' is Banister TRIMP, and WorkoutAnalyzer stores computeTRIMP's Banister/Edwards value into WorkoutMetadata.luciaTRIMP (WorkoutAnalyzer.swift:143), but that field is documented as 'Lucia TRIMP keyed to the user's HRVT-derived thresholds' (WorkoutMetadata.swift:341-343). The field name and comment contradict both the paper and the code that writes it, so anyone tracing the ladder from the paper finds a differently-described metric.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.3 Training load > 3.3.4 Scales and the daily series
units.does: Specifies scales (TSS-like vs Banister, labeled, unconverted) and the daily series: per-workout cap 1000, summary TRIMP fallback, per-day sum capped 1200, EWMA with tau 7/42 days, TSB = CTL - ATL. Code: HealthWorkoutSummary.effectiveLoad/cappedLoad (HealthDataTypes.swift:333-360), TrainingLoadSeries.dailyLoad/replay/point/Point.stepped (TrainingLoadSeries.swift:34-100).

units.does: Specifies route matching for run/trailRun/walk/hike/bike saved routes: >=2 points and >=500 m traveled; both directions; start within 150 m; prefix L+200 m thinned to 5 m; live track subsampled to 300; mean nearest distance <=30 m; best fit wins. Code: RouteLibrary.findMatch/candidates/scoreDirection/evenSample/thinned/trackPrefix/meanNearestDistance/nearestDistance (RouteLibrary.swift:27-210).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.4 Route-matched load substitution > 3.4.2 Earlier runs and the estimate
units.does: Specifies priors (ended before the first GPS fix, same sport, not partial, not substituted, start within 150 m of either route end, whole track re-matches the route), TRIMP/m ratios with <0.5 x median dropped, five estimate cases (no estimate when today >=0.7 prior; 60/40 blend; prior only; today only at 0.4; none), confidence min(0.85, 0.4+0.15n), target distance rules (saved distance when missing, within 0.9-1.1, or short and truncated). Code: RouteTRIMPEstimator.estimate/priorTRIMPPerMetre/withoutOutliers/trimpPerMetre/targetDistance/recordingMayBeTruncated/scaledEstimate/priorSessionsOnRoute/endAnchors/isCleanPrior/startsNear/ranRoute (RouteTRIMPEstimator.swift:87-266).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.5 Training readiness > 3.5.1 Daily score
units.does: Specifies daily readiness: acute = 0.30 * sum(load e^(-h/24)) over 72 h when todayTrimp > 0, else 0.35 * todayTrimp; base from (ATL+acute)/CTL through 0->100, 0.8->85, 1.0->70, 1.3->50, 1.5->30, 2.0->10 when CTL>=3.2, else max(10, 100-0.5(ATL+raw)); ACWR>1.3 penalty min(0.05+0.5(ACWR-1.3),0.40)*min(CTL/50,1), capped 0.10 when recovery >=70; freshness min(1.5*max(0,anchorATL-ATL),20); asymmetric blend (trust min(CTL/40,1)*0.55 above, uplift 0.30 below); non-finite -> 50, clamp 0-100; labels 7/4.5/2 on /10. Code: ReadinessScoring.calculateReadiness/computeAcuteFatigue/computeBaseReadiness/mapCapacityRatioToReadiness/applyACWRModifier/dampenedACWRPenalty/applyFreshnessBonus/applyRecoveryModulation/readinessLabel (ReadinessScoring.swift:118-360), constants Constants+RecoveryScore.swift:112-222.

flags.text: The paper states no penalty is applied for a low ACWR, and ReadinessScoring never applies one, but RecoveryScoreConstants.Readiness still declares acwrDetrainingThreshold 0.8, acwrDetrainingPenaltySlope 0.20 and acwrDetrainingPenaltyCap 0.10; grep of the repo (incl. tests) finds no reader of any of them.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.5 Training readiness > 3.5.2 Frozen morning value and live interpolation
units.does: Specifies frozen morning readiness (todayTrimp 0, anchor = ATL, ACWR = ATL/CTL, stored /10) and live interpolation f = clamp(h/24,0,1) of ATL and CTL from the frozen snapshot, anchor ATL_m except at f=1; no training metrics -> readiness equals recovery; narrative at >=3 point gap. Code: ReanalysisService.computeFrozenReadiness, LiveReadiness.compute/readiness/morningOnly/gateLoad/interpolatedLoad/headline/recentWorkoutLoads/computeRawAcuteFatigue (LiveReadiness.swift:63-290).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.6 Fusing the two strap paths > 3.6.1 Per-tick routing
units.does: Specifies per-tick routing: phone beats to the analyzer and live HR = 60000/median(last 8 RR>0) setting lastStrapHRAt; Watch relay considered only if Watch strap data <10 s old, queue always drained and range-filtered, beats used only when phone strap is silent >=5 s, re-timed on the phone stream clock backward from batch arrival, fed to a separate buffer and the analyzer; arbitration to wrist HR (<=30 s old) after >10 s silence on both channels, strap notice after 15 s of recording while both silent, Watch mode always wrist. Code: ingestStrapBeatsAndDeriveHR/medianSmoothedHR/consumeWatchRoutedStrapFallback/phoneStrapIsLive/synthesizeWatchRoutedPoints/alignWatchClock/streamClockBaseEpochMs/applyWatchRoutedHR/arbitrateHRSource/freshWristHR/HRArbitration.decide/strapNotice (WorkoutRecorder+Ticker.swift:294-975).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.6 Fusing the two strap paths > 3.6.2 Merge at finalize
units.does: Specifies finalize merge: start from the phone buffer only if source is strap; no Watch beats -> phone buffer; any point lacking wallClockMs -> concatenate and sort by t_ms; else interleave by wallClockMs phone-first on ties keeping each side's order; rebuild t_ms as the running RR sum. Code: WorkoutRRMerge.merged/interleaved/retimed (WorkoutRRMerge.swift:44-80).

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 3. Methods > 3.7 Per-split α1 and decoupling (standard)
units.does: Specifies per-split alpha1 (mean sample alpha1 in the split's time window found by walking the track) and Pa:Hr decoupling (halves of moving time, EF per half on the gap-corrected timeline, (EF1-EF2)/EF1*100, withheld under 5 min or 500 m). Code: WorkoutAnalyzer.computeDecoupling (WorkoutAnalyzer.swift:563-590) and split computation in WorkoutAnalyzer.

units.key: § Emuqu — Real-Time DFA α1 and Dropout-Robust Training Load > 6. Verification
units.does: Claims a Python reimplementation reproduced 114/114 unit-test cases across eight suites (including DFAAnalysisTests 15, DFAReferenceValidationTests 9, LiveDFAAnalyzerTests 19) and reports injected-artifact results on nsr2db (Table 6.1). Results live in Tools/validation/RESULTS.md (exists). Test-count claims were not recounted for these three suites here.

flags.text: Paper says the port reproduced 'LiveDFAAnalyzerTests (19 of 19)' and 114 of 114 cases across eight suites. LiveDFAAnalyzerTests had 21 tests at e028039 (and now); the port only ports cleanRRForDFA cases and skips testAlpha1IsNotProducedBeforeTheWindowIsFull and testAlpha1IsProducedOnceTheWindowIsFull, i.e. the live window-fill gate the paper describes. Across the eight suites 14 of 128 test functions were not reproduced, and DFAReferenceValidationTests' '9 of 9' counts a 'quoted' pseudo-case over 8 real tests.
